claims.label: Nominal concentration
claims.statement: The source labels the cadmium precursor solution 0.1 M.

claims.label: Recipe charges
claims.statement: The same paragraph uses 0.064 g CdO, 2.5 mL OA and 7 mL ODE, without a final solution volume. These charges do not straightforwardly reproduce the labelled concentration.

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Keep the reported concentration and input charges side by side. Do not recalculate or repair the recipe, infer a final volume, or resolve the unexpanded OA abbreviation.

claims.label: 400 nm prose
claims.statement: The text gives 1.61 ± 0.07 ps⁻¹ for 400 nm excitation and describes an approximately 0.7 ps timescale.
claims.locator: SI p. 13, paragraph before Table S1

claims.label: Table S1
claims.statement: The table assigns 1.61 ± 0.07 ps⁻¹ to the 495 nm hole-localization term and 1.50 ± 0.06 ps⁻¹ to the 400 nm term.
claims.locator: SI pp. 13–14, Table S1 and term definitions

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Display both source statements with their locators. Do not silently switch the excitation labels or refit the data.

claims.label: Caption
claims.statement: Figure S8 calls panel A with MV²⁺ and panel B without MV²⁺.

claims.label: Spectral and text context
claims.statement: Panel B contains the radical-band signal, and the accompanying discussion associates radical formation and accelerated bleach recovery with CdS–MV²⁺.
claims.locator: SI pp. 19–20, Figure S8 and CdS discussion

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Retain the published panel labels and state the inconsistency. Do not silently reverse the image labels or claim a resolved crosswalk.

evidence_conflicts.topic: Shell identity in the Burstein–Moss model caption

claims.label: Figure S11 caption
claims.statement: The caption refers once to a CdSe shell.

claims.label: Preparation and architecture
claims.statement: The preparation and surrounding analysis describe a CdSe core with a CdS shell.

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Preserve the caption discrepancy without changing the prepared architecture or creating a second specimen.

evidence_conflicts.topic: Measured particle diameter versus model diameter

claims.label: TEM result
claims.locator: SI p. 4, Figure S1 and text

claims.label: Effective-mass calculation
claims.statement: The calculation uses a 6.8 nm diameter.

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Store measurement and model input in separate scopes. Do not average them or present the model diameter as another synthesis product.

claims.label: Printed equations
claims.statement: Equations S1a, S1b, S1c, S1d and S1f show positive t/τrec exponents.

claims.label: Physical wording
claims.statement: The discussion treats recombination as decay and τrec as much longer than 1 ns.
claims.locator: SI pp. 12–14, Section 4 and Table S1

evidence_conflicts.disposition: Retain a source equation caveat. Do not silently repair signs or execute the equations as a validated kinetic model.
